description: Extend the exact batch-640 n=512 cp.async winner with a shape-scoped FP16 factor sidecar: convert each solved factor tile once, retain it for later rows, and double-buffer prior-factor triples through asynchronous shared staging. Tune sidecar layout, buffering, and live ranges while preserving the caller-current single-CTA schedule, output cache, every other dispatch, and all policy, reuse, fresh-input, correctness, and full-grid guards.

Added a shape-scoped FP16 factor sidecar for exact batch640 n512, converted solved tiles during their existing FP32 writeback, and double-buffered 16-byte cp.async prior-factor triples across paired MathDx updates in 24 KiB shared memory. Build, policy gates, 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Target measured 1923.096 us versus the 1797.401 parent; aggregate measured 931.274 us versus 923.827.

Packed the FP16 sidecar into 136 contiguous upper tiles per matrix and made each 16-byte asynchronous triple load tile-linear, reducing sidecar capacity from 256 to 136 tiles. Build, policy gates, 17 tests, and fresh-input validation passed, but the full benchmark did not return any cells after 1596.851 seconds and was terminated; no metric was accepted.

Replaced compact triangular addressing with a full 16x16 tile-major FP16 sidecar, retaining contiguous 16-byte cp.async triples and the two-bank overlap while removing dynamic packed-index arithmetic. Build, policy gates, 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Target improved from 1923.096 in the row-major sidecar to 1629.449 us and from the 1797.401 parent; aggregate improved to 915.683 us versus the 923.827 parent.

Extended the existing half-factor second bank to diagonal rank-k: 16-byte cp.async staged tile i+1 while MathDx consumed tile i, with no extra shared allocation. Build, policy gates, tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Target measured 1691.861 us versus 1629.449 without diagonal pipelining; aggregate measured 922.802 versus 915.683, so paired-panel triple overlap remains the measured stronger schedule.

Restored direct diagonal sidecar loads, then double-buffered the odd trailing panel's tile-major prior-factor pairs with 16-byte cp.async while MathDx consumed the preceding pair. Build, policy, correctness, fresh-input, and all 15 cells passed. Target measured 1614.876 us versus 1629.449 for triple-only staging, and aggregate measured 915.470 versus 915.683.

Stopped converting and writing diagonal tiles into the sidecar because subsequent rows consume only solved off-diagonal factors; retained FP32 diagonal output and both async pipelines. Build, policy, correctness, fresh-input, and full grid passed. This run measured 1760.426 us target / 930.344 aggregate versus 1614.876 / 915.470, with unusually high target dispersion (711.122 us std and an 11747.232 us worst sample).

Vectorized each retained sidecar tile conversion as four half2 stores per thread over contiguous eight-value shared fragments, separating tile-major half writeback from FP32 output writeback. Build, policy, correctness, fresh-input, and full grid passed. Target measured 1758.052 us versus 1760.426 for scalar stores in the preceding noisy run and 1614.876 for the best scalar-store run; aggregate measured 927.106 us.

Measured seven sidecar/pipeline variants. The row-major sidecar reached 1923.096 us target / 931.274 aggregate. Full tile-major layout made 16-byte triples contiguous and reached 1629.449 / 915.683; adding odd-panel pair buffering produced the best cebf4a0 at 1614.876 / 915.470 versus the 1797.401 / 923.827 parent. Compact triangular addressing passed validation but its benchmark did not return after 1596.851 seconds. Diagonal pipelining measured 1691.861 / 922.802. Diagonal-write elision had a noisy 1760.426 / 930.344 run with an 11.747 ms outlier, and half2 sidecar stores measured 1758.052 / 927.106. Every succeeded variant passed build, policy, 17 tests, fresh-input guards, and all 15 cells; local profiling was waived and hosted Brev unavailable. Keep this line moving with precomputed compact-sidecar bases, cp.async.bulk/TMA+mbarrier triple staging, or overlap of scalar sidecar conversion with the preceding TRSM/writeback without extending live ranges.
